changes_made.explanation: Added missing datasets (SVAMP, MAWPS mentioned in domain generalization section) and normalized dataset names. GSM is actually GSM8K. Added specific reasoning tasks mentioned in abstract and experiments. Removed vague 'reasoning tasks' category.

Normalized metric names to standard capitalization. Removed redundant/more-specific variants (completion likelihood, one-shot silver accuracy) as they are all fundamentally measuring accuracy or likelihood. Consolidated 'log-likelihood' and 'log likelihood' to 'Log Likelihood'.

changes_made.explanation: Removed all metadata as the paper does NOT use LLMs as judges. The LLMs mentioned are used for generation and internal scoring, but not for evaluating/assessing the generated explanations after they are produced. Silver labeling is part of the training/optimization process, not evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper - all evaluation is automated using accuracy and likelihood metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on optimizing explanations for chain-of-thought prompting using automated methods. The extraction was generally good but missed some secondary datasets and specific reasoning tasks. Key clarification: LLMs are used for generation/internal optimization but NOT as judges/evaluators of the final outputs.
